posts.author: Invisnir
posts.body:
Hey fellows, Invisnir here!
I'm looking for a team on my game NONE
NONE is a rpg based on OFF that will be made in RPG maker 2000 or 2003
(or some other rpg maker engine)
i need someone to make charsets, tilesets, and enemies I'll be making the game and it's english and brazilian translations.
instructions for the charset and enemy makers:
i know how they are supposed to look like, so do not make any sprite before i show you a artwork of them. the artworks will be most likely to come up on email.
instructions for the engine users:
The game will have a Brazilian version, so you will need my help to translate it.
Game Plot:
The world is affected by a prophecy where everyone has a role, and if you don't follow that role, god will punish you. The protagonist is Mateu. A Bully teenager given the role of the good guy, But he doesn't belive in the prophecy. One day, Mateu was Bullying a kid when suddenly, a meteor hit him. (don't worry, he survived) When he woke up he found himself in an abandoned place that looked like ruins. And from there the player controls Mateu, so this is all i can say of the story for now...
Gameplay:
Your average rpg/rpg maker game
